[LADP.8.1] Adapters that host services (`call light.turn_on`,
`call mqtt.publish`, `call weather.get_forecasts`) declare
those services in the adapter's `.ds` library file. Rule
files reference an adapter's services by `import`ing the
adapter library per [LIMP]. At runtime,
the integrator's adapter binary registers per-service
callbacks against libds's C API; the compiled DSC carries
the service set the engine binds against.
